population: Declared synthetic workload only: six independently authored fixed-answer cases spanning supportFAQ, onboarding, incident, release-readiness, refund, and brokerlifecycle. Each case has ten framing paraphrases that preserve facts, scope, and answer form, plus ten changed-request challenges. These correlated authored pairs do not establish general held-out representativeness or real-user acceptance.
label_rule: should_reuse is true exactly when the unchanged cached answer fully and correctly satisfies the variant question under the stated instructions and evidence, including scope, language, output form, temporal qualification, uncertainty, and read-only action limits. A negative label means a materially different answer or action response is required; high topical similarity is insufficient. Labels and source answers were frozen before live validation and without inspecting verifier prompts, guard implementations, or prior corpora/results.
retrieval_threshold_meaning: Cosine retrieval cutoff only; it is not a validity confidence or quality estimate.
quality_target_meaning: The requested 90–98% target is not a universal guarantee. Metrics and Wilson intervals describe this declared sample only; corpus selection and dependence limit generalization.
metric_meaning: TP/FP/TN/FN classify served versus withheld for every labelled pair, including abstentions. Accuracy counts correct serve/withhold decisions; coverage is served/total. Errors, unknowns and unattempted pairs remain visible. Precision is null when nothing is served.
model_call_basis: Logical embedding Embed calls plus verifier Generate calls reported by the inference runner; metadata reads and token-count preflight requests are excluded. Verification attempts, cached verifications and unknown usage are separate.
